label: def:demand-profile
title: Demand profile of a derived atom
html:
Definition. Demand profile of a derived atom

Definition. Let \mathcal{A}(Z, N) = \sum_w c_w \cdot w be a derived atom in normal form. Its demand profile is

  \mathrm{dem}(\mathcal{A})
  \;=\;
  \{(w, c_w) : c_w < 0\}
  \;\subset\;
  \mathrm{NF}(B_A) \times \mathbb{R}_{<0}.

The demand magnitude is |\mathrm{dem}| = \sum_{c_w < 0} |c_w|.

Archimedean specialisation. What follows invokes real- or complex-analytic constructs. Categorical identities remain valid over an abstract coefficient ring; their archimedean realisation is specialised here.
